signup.number_taken.text: This number don dey use Taskiem before. To use Taskiem here too, sign in, open {where}, and link this chat.

dormant.relink.text: This chat don quiet for {days} days, so Taskiem stop to use am until you show say na still you. Sign in, open {where} and link am again, or use Taskiem from your other chat. If you no prove am, we go unlink am after another {days} days.

chatpin.not_here.text: You no fit set chat PIN from here yet: set am from WhatsApp, where Taskiem dey send secure form.

chatpin.summary.text: Six numbers wey keep this chat for you

connect.link.text:
Connect {service} for here: {link}

connect.denied.text: Na only person wey dey manage connections for {org} fit connect services. Ask the owner.

connect.unknown.text: Taskiem no get service wey dem call {service}. Check the name, like *connect paystack*.

connect.form.text: Tap the button to connect {service}. Type the key for the form, no type am for this chat: Taskiem go check am with {service} before e save am.

connect.form_intro.text: Copy each value from {service} and paste am here. Taskiem go check am with {service} before e save am.

terms.ask.text:
Taskiem get terms and privacy notice wey you never agree to: {link}

Tap *I agree*, or reply *I agree*. Taskiem go still dey work anyhow.

terms.thanks.text: Thank you: we don record say you agree.

link.found_pick.text: Send the number of the one wey you wan link with, or *cancel*.

link.denied.text: Na only owner or admin of {org} fit link with other businesses.
